title: 第15章 单挑群雄你们一起上第16章 局势严峻魔尊危矣
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
林云的话像是捅了马蜂窝。
那位女皇，可是很多人心中的白月光。
虽然现在孩子都这么大了。
但是神凰皇朝的培养体系比较特殊。
作为凰女，其实是终生不嫁的。
而现任凰女公主是怎么孕育出来的。
那就涉及到神凰皇朝的根基隐秘了，外人自然无从知晓。
只是据传和凤凰有关。
林云看着凰曦儿，也是目光闪动。
此女倒是生的一副好样貌。
不给自己做炉鼎可惜了。
而且可以利用一下，到时候直接要挟女皇。
对于凰怜月的滋味，林云可很是怀念。
而且，当年他也是真的喜欢她。
甚至想过加入神凰皇朝改头换面算了。
但是没想到，她居然对魔宗的成见这么深。
再说了，我阴阳圣宗在久远的曾经也是仙道宗门啊！
林云身份曝光的时候。
凰怜月竟然直接出卖了他的消息。
导致他被一群仙道天骄围杀。

然后也一战成名。
当然林云和她之间的故事，也就此结束了。
而且还诞生了仇怨。
直到他成为了掌教至尊，魔道巨擘。
两人也是老死不相往来。
直到林云某次突发奇想，把已经是女皇的对方哄了出来。
说什么见最后一面，往事如烟，就都过去了。
然后直接下药把对方绑回了宗门。
这么大的事情，自然是瞒不住的，神凰皇朝凭借某种秘法还是发现了女皇的踪迹。
这段隐秘在当年可是最炸裂的传闻。
直接把仙魔对立推向了高潮。
所以仙道那边对此都是引以为耻。
神凰皇朝作为唯一的修行皇朝，地位其实也很是特殊。
和各大宗门之间的关系都盘根错节利益相通。
毕竟他们仙宗也是要下山收弟子的。
而神凰皇朝，就是人口数百亿的最大生源地。
而且因为皇朝气运的缘故，资质都是上上之选，经常出现妖孽。
天玄宗的玄天罡第一个忍不住了，当年他可是凰女的舔狗。
只是长相嘛，有些粗犷。
玄天罡怒吼：“无耻魔头，嘴贱至此，拿命来吧！”

他都懒得多费口舌了，众所周知，林老魔巧舌如簧。
到时候吵起来肯定占不到便宜。
玄天罡一拍天玄印，巨印轰然砸下。
紫霄宗的雷震霄满脸胡茬抖了抖，他本就脾气火爆，此刻一脸冷笑：“老子劈死你这不要脸的邪魔歪道！”
紫霄宗的弟子一起发力，组成的雷阵轰鸣，雷光如龙。
content_en:
Lin Yun's words were like poking a hornet's nest.
That queen is Bai Yueguang in many people's hearts.
Although the children are so old now.
However, the training system of the Divine Phoenix Dynasty is rather special.
As a phoenix girl, she actually never marries for life.
And how was the current Princess Huangnu conceived.
That involves the secrets of the foundation of the Divine Phoenix Dynasty, which outsiders naturally have no way of knowing.
It's just rumored to be related to Phoenix.
Lin Yun looked at Huang Xi'er, his eyes flashing as well.
This girl is quite good-looking.
It would be a pity not to make a furnace for yourself.
And you can use it to directly blackmail the queen.
Lin Yun missed Huang Lianyue's taste very much.
Moreover, he really liked her back then.
He even thought about joining the Divine Phoenix Dynasty and changing his appearance.
But she didn't expect that she would be so prejudiced against the Demon Sect.
Besides, my Yin-Yang Holy Sect was also an Immortal Sect in the distant past!
When Lin Yun's identity was exposed.
Huang Lianyue actually directly betrayed his information.
As a result, he was surrounded and killed by a group of immortal geniuses.
Then he became famous in one battle.
Of course, the story between Lin Yun and her ended here.
And hatred was born.
Until he became the supreme leader and a giant of the devil.
The two of them have never interacted with each other.
Until Lin Yun had a sudden idea and coaxed the other party who was already the queen out.
It is said that when we saw each other for the last time, the past was like smoke, it was all over.
Then he directly drugged the other party and tied him back to the sect.
Naturally, such a big thing cannot be hidden. The Divine Phoenix Dynasty still discovered traces of the Queen with some secret method.
This secret was the most explosive rumor at the time.
Directly pushing the confrontation between immortals and demons to a climax.
So the Immortals are all ashamed of this.
As the only cultivating dynasty, the Divine Phoenix Dynasty has a very special status.
The relationships between the major sects are intricately intertwined and the interests are interlinked.
After all, their Immortal Sect also wants to go down the mountain to recruit disciples.
The Shenhuang Dynasty was the largest birthplace with a population of tens of billions.
And because of the luck of the dynasty, the qualifications are always the best, and monsters often appear.
Xuan Tiangang of Tianxuan Sect was the first to be unable to bear it any longer. Back then, he was Huang Nu's licking dog.
It's just his appearance, a bit rough.
Xuan Tiangang roared angrily: "Shameless devil, you are so mean-mouthed, take your life!"
He didn't even bother to talk anymore. As we all know, Old Devil Lin was very eloquent.
There will definitely be no advantage if we quarrel by then.
Xuan Tiangang slapped the Tianxuan Seal, and the giant seal crashed down.
Lei Zhenxiao from the Zixiao Sect trembled with his stubble on his face. He already had a hot temper, but now he had a sneer on his face: "I'll kill you for your shameless evil ways!"
The disciples of Zixiao Sect worked together, and the thunder formation roared, and the thunder light was like a dragon.
